title: Body Temperature Fell Below The 98.6°F Standard
hook: The old standard stayed fixed while human bodies cooled.
closing: A single normal temperature cannot capture a body that changed across generations.
question: What's your resting temperature?

segments.say: Modern men average 97.5 degrees, showing the body runs cooler than it once did.
Men cooled by 1.06 degrees, nearly twice the drop for women, pointing to a real biological shift.
A recalculation put the old thermometer average at 98.2 degrees, so the standard was never as fixed as bodies seemed.
